premise: Useful movement phase is present in spinal measurements
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: El Hadwe 2026 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-75128-z and Fan 2023 https://advanced.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/advs.202303377 support movement-related animal recordings
unverified_extrapolation: Useful causal human phase decoding at the selected contacts during practice is not established
adopted_model_value_or_rule: 16 abstract features z=H*phi+noise; H learned from externally labelled initial calibration
engineering_requirement: Timestamp sample support and availability; carry decoder calibration identity and validity
invalidation_and_consequence: Features absent or delayed beyond useful phase prediction invalidate neural mode; use declared external fallback or withdraw assistance

premise: Expert coordination can be represented and aligned to a learner
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Motor-evidence M-A02; primitive organization and individualized recruitment motivate a task-space representation
unverified_extrapolation: Human expert representation transferable between bodies is unproven; an expert label alone supplies no skill
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Offline reference for a bounded two-dimensional cyclic component; no voltage replay
engineering_requirement: Reference includes task and context identity plus body alignment and training provenance
invalidation_and_consequence: Reference mismatch or wrong context can worsen assistance; restrict reference or recalibrate rather than claim complete skill transfer

premise: Selected spinal programs can generate the required local task-space corrections
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Rowald 2022 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-021-01663-5 and de Freitas 2026 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04435-1 motivate individualized recruitment
unverified_extrapolation: The learner-specific B map and its stability during healthy practice remain assumed
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Separate programs provide opposing reachable task directions through B; weak and changed gains are scenario cases
engineering_requirement: Bind program and route to a calibrated task-space direction with amplitude and context limits
invalidation_and_consequence: Missing direction or changed recruitment invalidates that correction; restrict reachable action set or withdraw; negative current is not evidence of inhibition

premise: Assisted active practice can change retained learning
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: McPherson 2015 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4593107/ and Nishimura 2013 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4079851/ motivate contingent adaptation
unverified_extrapolation: Healthy acquisition benefit and the effective teaching coefficient are unmeasured; injury recovery is not expert transfer
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Effective teaching rho is swept through -1;0;1;2 rather than fitted from literature
engineering_requirement: Log active attempt and delivered response separately; score stimulation-OFF probes after practice
invalidation_and_consequence: No retained advantage or adverse adaptation limits the learning claim even when ON execution improves

premise: A common OFF probe supports learner model estimation
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Independent external outcome observation prevents command from becoming its own evidence
unverified_extrapolation: Finite noisy probes may not identify a stable voluntary response model
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Estimate theta_hat from equal-duration OFF probes using measured outcomes; no private theta input to the controller
engineering_requirement: Maintain probe duration and phase coverage plus estimation uncertainty and session identity
invalidation_and_consequence: Insufficient excitation or changing learner state makes the estimate unreliable; reduce intervention or repeat calibration

premise: Expert neural reference and live learner neural input have separable value
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Motor-evidence M-A05; recording and stimulation results do not establish incremental neural benefit
unverified_extrapolation: Spinal inputs may duplicate externally available phase or contribute only better assumed noise or latency
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Compare OFF; expert-external; expert-spinal-reference-with-externalstate; spinal-live; phase-shifted arms
engineering_requirement: Account for reference information and learner-state sensing separately; match exposure and report all resource differences
invalidation_and_consequence: Equal information with the same stochastic draws must produce identical policy behavior; any advantage from assigned latency or noise is conditional rather than neural specificity evidence

premise: External labels and feedback are available with declared quality
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Independent movement sensing supplies labels and functional outcomes in recording and assistance precedents
unverified_extrapolation: Chosen sensor latency and accuracy are not established for mobile consumer use
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Trajectory sensor alternative has explicit latency and noise; prediction uses a known 1 Hz cue rather than future achieved movement
engineering_requirement: Packet carries physical support time and arrival time plus quality and calibration; distinguish task instruction from observation
invalidation_and_consequence: Late or missing feedback invalidates fresh-state claims; predict only within declared support or fall back and withdraw

premise: Spinal features can be acquired during the selected sensing windows
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Animal recording motivates acquisition; Formento 2018 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6268129/ motivates preserving sensory information
unverified_extrapolation: Artifact recovery and useful dense-stimulation neural availability are not demonstrated by the abstract feature generator
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Feature-absence case exercises fallback; dense stimulation does not automatically grant valid neural samples
engineering_requirement: AFE protection and recovery plus blanking and validity need circuit evidence; stale features retain their original age
invalidation_and_consequence: Unqualified artifact-contaminated features cannot authorize neural control; use explicit external sensing or inhibit

premise: The future actuator delivers bounded commands within a declared effective range
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Current and charge monitoring can observe electrical delivery independently of request
unverified_extrapolation: Normalized dose and future precision are not earned by the current native monitoring candidate
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Nominal normalized dose 1.0; changed gain and timing explored; no clinical current or charge prescription
engineering_requirement: Measure both phase charges and compliance plus recovery tail; preserve interrupted phases and independent inhibit
invalidation_and_consequence: Unexpected dose or precision failure blocks hardware efficacy claims; retain the historical conservative result and revise circuit requirements

premise: A selected lower-thoracic pathway offers positive pressor authority with external pressure feedback
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Phillips 2025 https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-025-03614-w supports a selected SCI feedback mechanism
unverified_extrapolation: Healthy benefit and an interchangeable pressure-related spinal decoder remain unproven
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Primary pressure measurement is external; spinal ECAP or context is optional and separately labelled; input is nonnegative
engineering_requirement: Target-specific recruitment and pressure sensor freshness; saturation handling and high-pressure withdrawal; independent electrical monitoring
invalidation_and_consequence: Zero or adverse pressor gain invalidates that local model; zero command removes added drive but does not actively lower arbitrary hypertension

premise: The future implant can maintain useful access and a viable package
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Animal chronic recording and clinical implanted stimulation motivate development but validate different arrangements
unverified_extrapolation: SCCI_RH combined chronic consumer access and simultaneous subsystem lifetime are unestablished
adopted_model_value_or_rule: Use target-specific configured variants; preserve current allocation envelopes until populated design exists
engineering_requirement: Recalculate component power and heat; verify lead strain relief and feedthrough allocation plus materials and signal integrity
invalidation_and_consequence: Loss of useful access or packaging margin forces geometry and architecture revision; CAD appearance is not lifetime or biocompatibility evidence

premise: Retain the Stage 2 resource identity until openly revised
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: docs/stage2/selected-design.md and docs/stage2/acquisition-and-compute.md are quantitative allocation contracts
unverified_extrapolation: Selected stream count and catalog components do not prove biological sufficiency or target implementation
adopted_model_value_or_rule: 16 differential streams at 4 ksample/s each; two independent stimulation sources maximum; initial modes exclusive
engineering_requirement: Respect physical apertures and aggregate buses; map 36 allocated body ports explicitly; two sources do not imply unlimited signed program availability
invalidation_and_consequence: More channels or sources require new processing and power and feedthrough budgets; coexistence of anatomical lead sets needs an explicit partition

premise: Use a compact geometry to demonstrate conditional operation
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: The model is an explanatory construction rather than a physiological fit
unverified_extrapolation: Two-dimensional cyclic error does not represent all piano or football skill
adopted_model_value_or_rule: x=theta*phi+B*activation; abstract signals encode phase; normalized task and dose units
engineering_requirement: Expose numerical units and mapping assumptions; keep physical electrode and stimulation specifications in separate engineering records
invalidation_and_consequence: Failure of the surrogate to predict real task variables limits applicability; do not translate normalized gains directly into clinical settings

premise: Separate immediate assistance from retained learner change
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: An explicit update permits causal sensitivity analysis without inventing an empirical effect size
unverified_extrapolation: eta and rho have no fitted healthy biological meaning
engineering_requirement: Keep the same learning rule and exposure across arms; OFF assessment removes activation rather than relabelling an ON score
invalidation_and_consequence: For identical features and feedback rho=1 algebraically cancels the assistance contribution; favorable rho results remain conditional and do not establish a human speed multiplier

premise: Finite sensing and actuation delays influence phase assistance
mechanistic_rationale_and_evidence_ancho: Known task instructions can support causal extrapolation while achieved motion remains unavailable until sensed
unverified_extrapolation: Selected frame and response times are design assumptions rather than imported synaptic windows
adopted_model_value_or_rule: 1 Hz declared cue; 25 ms frame hold; 40 ms activation lag; 35 ms onset; late-feedback cases
engineering_requirement: Distinguish support age and computation delay and frame wait and physical onset; benchmark target execution later
invalidation_and_consequence: Large phase error may remove or reverse useful assistance; no timing value is certified by a successful desktop calculation
